notes.zh-CN: 完成编辑时选择覆盖或另存，保存后恢复文字识别与划词。
notes.en-US: Choose overwrite or Save as when finishing edits, then recognize and select text again.

notes.zh-CN: Windows 0.1.14：更新下载期间移除取消按钮并增加退出提示；下载完成后可重启静默安装新版。
notes.en-US: Windows 0.1.14: downloads no longer show a Cancel button, quitting prompts while downloading, and downloaded updates install silently on restart.

zh-CN.title: 更新体验
items: 下载更新期间隐藏取消按钮、禁止切换线路，退出时提示并保留已下载内容。
下载完成后可重启以静默安装新版；安装前重新校验安装包，安装失败不会反复自动安装。
修复 Windows 更新记录显示，官网按访问设备默认选择 Windows 或 Mac 下载。
本次发布为 Windows x64；macOS 保持 0.1.12。

en-US.title: Update experience
items: Hide Cancel and disable source changes during downloads; prompt before quitting and retain partial downloads.
Restart to install downloaded updates silently; revalidate packages before installation and avoid repeated failed installs.
Show Windows-specific release notes and choose the website download platform from the visiting device.
This release is for Windows x64; macOS remains on 0.1.12.

zh-CN.title: Windows 更新
items: 启动统计接入 PostHog，可在设置中关闭使用统计。
官网安装包和客户端更新包通过 Cloudflare CDN 分发。
本次发布为 Windows x64；macOS 保持 0.1.12。

en-US.title: Windows update
items: Startup statistics use PostHog and can be disabled in Settings.
Website downloads and client update packages use Cloudflare CDN.
This release is for Windows x64; macOS remains on 0.1.12.

zh-CN.title: 更新
items: 完成编辑时即可选择覆盖原图或另存为，不再等到切图时才提示保存。
取消另存或保存失败时保留编辑，放弃修改可返回已保存的图片。
保存后自动重新识别文字，修复旧识别结果回填和编辑后无法划词的问题。
保存确认采用紧凑圆角样式，适配深浅主题与中英文。
默认标注线条更细，减少对图片内容的遮挡。

en-US.title: Changes
items: Choose Overwrite or Save as when finishing an edit, before returning to the viewer.
Keep edits when saving is cancelled or fails; discard returns to the last saved image.
Recognize text again after saving and prevent stale OCR results from disabling text selection.
Use a compact rounded save dialog in light and dark themes, in English and Chinese.
Use thinner default annotation strokes.
